title: How a Bread Maker Works in 60 Seconds 🍞⚙️ #shorts
description:
A bread maker turns flour, water and yeast into a loaf by itself. A motor spins a kneading paddle to build gluten, gentle warmth lets the yeast raise the dough, and a heating element bakes it right in the pan, all run by a timer chip. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#breadmaker #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Drop in flour, water and yeast, and a bread maker does *everything else*.

steps.label: Paddle
steps.text: A motor under the pan spins a *kneading paddle* through the dough.

steps.label: Gluten
steps.text: Kneading stretches the dough, building strong, stretchy *gluten* strands.

steps.label: Rise
steps.text: Then the motor rests, and gentle *warmth* lets the yeast puff the dough up.

steps.label: Bake
steps.text: A *heating element* around the pan turns hot and bakes the loaf in place.

steps.label: Timer
steps.text: A *timer chip* runs every stage, so you get a *golden crust* hours later.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Knead, rise, *bake*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
